css: .retail-print{font-family:'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;color:#1f2937;font-size:12px}.retail-print .header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;border-bottom:2px solid #1f2937;padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:16px}.retail-print .doc-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;margin:0}.retail-print .muted{color:#6b7280;font-size:11px}.retail-print .two-col{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px}.retail-print table.items{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:12px 0}.retail-print table.items th{background:#f3f4f6;text-align:left;padding:6px 8px;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;border-bottom:1px solid #d1d5db}.retail-print table.items td{padding:6px 8px;font-size:11px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e7eb}.retail-print .section-title{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6b7280;margin-top:16px;margin-bottom:4px}
